title: ZC Labs Made Zombkolaps Potion!
author: Discoveries Against Turning (DAT) Foundation
pages: We received a report from an anonymous whistleblower within ZC Labs Inc that the company developed a potion that spreads Zombkolaps!
The DAT Foundation believes that the report is credible; our watchers noted a decrease of ZC Lab CCC agent activity while ZC Labs’ laboratories remain functional.
It’s implausible that the labs can maintain their experiments and near 100% cure rate without surplus zombies.
The DAT Foundation wholeheartedly condemns the development of a Zombkolaps potion.
For the sake of everyone, we demand that ZC Labs provide a truthful statement about this development that commits to the destruction of all copies of the Zombkolaps potion and its associated recipe.
This potion threatens everyone. If released or sold, this potion can be used to assassinate anyone or wipe out villages.
This could be used as a weapon for warfare, where these weapons can be used to overwhelm entire areas of the world by outpacing cure production.
And in a world where Zombkolaps ceases to exist, this potion could start the Kolaps all over again.

ZC Labs must commit to destroying this potion for all of our sakes.
Page10: We can remember the world of before, we just have to fight to bring it back.
